world.title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says

world.title: Saudi man charged with planting 'sophisticated' recording device in OpenAI office

world.description: The Saudi-led coalition fighting in Yemen struck a fuel depot near the Houthi-controlled capital, Sanaa.

US.description: Locals and preservationists have long opposed Trump's plan to redevelop a municipal D.C. golf course. That legal fight escalated after the government cleared hundreds of trees on short notice.

US.description: In a letter, Cornell's president apologized for what happened to the student who alleges she was raped by several men at a fraternity house in 2024 and promised 'meaningful action.'

US.description: The government is using millions of taxpayers' dollars on pro-Trump ads, even after the president said this would not happen. And, federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home.

US.title: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in former prime minister's stronghold

US.title: What ice cream has to do with this year's Nobel Prize in economics
